prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: four polished passive-skill emblem sprites for an original hand-painted dark fantasy 2D action game UI.
Primary request: Generate ONE actual transparent RGBA PNG sprite atlas, preferably 1024×1024 square, with exactly FOUR separate magical skill emblems arranged in an invisible TWO-column TWO-row grid. Each emblem is an individual cutout object on true transparency, not a rectangular inventory card. Native output size is acceptable, maintain square 2×2 arrangement. Broad transparent margins around each object and between all four; no part crosses a cell boundary.
Composition: Center each isolated emblem inside its own quarter. Each emblem occupies roughly 62–68% of its cell, with a strong readable silhouette for small UI use. Consistent elegant pale antique-gold material on each emblem's delicate outer sculpted edges, but no square or circular panel behind the symbol. Emblems may have shaped organic ornamental edging that follows their own symbol silhouette. No enclosing rectangular frame.
Exact reading order:
TOP LEFT — health regeneration each second: a compact sacred healing emblem combining a graceful GOLD-GREEN TREE OF LIFE and one clearly visible deep emerald healing blood-drop-shaped gem. Leafy luminous life energy and flowing root curves integrated into one sculpted form. Rich gold and forest-green material, easily read as health and renewal. No anatomical blood or gore.
TOP RIGHT — mana regeneration each second: a BLUE-SILVER ARCANE FOUNTAIN flowing around a large sapphire MANA CRYSTAL. Clearly visible downward and upward flowing water ribbons, compact polished silver accents edged with the same pale gold. Blue and silver dominate, distinct silhouette from the tree.
BOTTOM LEFT — increased critical-hit chance: a SHARP GOLDEN AIMING STAR combined with a clean upward diagonal SWORD EDGE, precise small ray points and a focused central glint. Strong controlled geometric star and blade shape, pale gold and cool steel, clean center, communicates precision and chance to critically strike. No red explosion.
BOTTOM RIGHT — increased critical-hit damage: a RED-GOLD SHATTERED SWORD BLADE BURST, three powerful sharp broken blade fragments radiating outward around a ruby-red impact crystal, compact jagged explosive rays integrated into the emblem itself. Red and antique gold dominate; clearly more forceful and fractured than the precise aiming emblem. No large cloud or detached particles.
Style/medium: refined detailed original hand-painted dark fantasy game art with sculptural metallic ornament, small gemstone facets, subtle etched detail, controlled painterly rim light. Beautiful and somewhat lavish, but clear simple large shapes remain readable at small icon size. A cohesive collection with consistent pale gold edge treatment. Distinct blue, green, gold and red identities. Moderate restrained glow confined within or immediately against each emblem, no broad translucent aura.
Transparency/constraints: Actual clean alpha transparency outside the four precise emblem silhouettes. Leave large genuinely empty transparent spaces between all emblems and at all outer borders. No text, letters, numbers, labels, grid lines, square black backgrounds, dark tiles, cards, background panels, glowing rectangular frames, opaque circular backing discs, checkerboard, vignette, scenery, UI mockup, watermark, person or character. No detached dust, sparks or particles spreading into the gaps. Only the four standalone polished magical skill emblems, each fully contained in its own quarter.
